title: Sa'd makes Al-Medain the seat of government
description: Finding Al-Medain convenient for the seat of government, Sa'd established himself there, occupied the royal residence himself and divided the palaces and mansions of the fugitive nobles among his followers (A.H. 15-16). Dated to the year 0637 by the source.

sources.citation: Sir William Muir, The Caliphate: Its Rise, Decline, and Fall, "A.H. 15-16."
